title: Settings
reply_motion_hint: New replies fade in word by word. Off when the system's Reduce motion is on.
sidebar_terminals_hint: When agents are grouped by machine, each computer lists the plain shells in its terminal under its agents; click one to open its Terminal page. Off by default; applies to this browser only.
avatar_footer: Persona's name, avatar, the site's logo and tab icon, and the moving state in conversations; synced across your devices when the hub supports it. With the theme color set to follow the avatar, the site's colors follow it too. Extensions can add avatars.
assistant_footer: Each chat runs in the background on {machine}. Pick models in Model settings; manage connections and credentials in Model providers.
this_browser_footer: Disconnecting revokes this browser's token; next time you'll paste the hub's token again. The hub uses plain HTTP by default, so use it only on your local network or VPN.
linked_hubs_hint: Computers on these hubs are listed here too, reached through this hub
install_installed: Already open in its own window
install_prompt: Install to your desktop or home screen and open it in its own window
install_ios: In Safari's Share menu, choose Add to Home Screen
install_safari: In Safari's File menu, choose Add to Dock
install_insecure: Open the hub over HTTPS to install
install_menu: In the browser menu, choose Install or Add to Home Screen
managed_footer: Keys are stored encrypted on the hub. Direct APIs are called by the hub; launchers run as personad launch <name>.
managed_empty: None yet. Choose Add provider, pick one and paste its key. Pick what uses it under Models.
zshrc_footer: Functions and aliases that call claude / codex in each computer's login shell config (~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc), synced each time you open this page. New ones show up on their own.
path_footer: Wrapper scripts on each computer's PATH that start claude, and the runtimes' own launchers, synced each time you open this page.
hidden_footer: Only hidden in Persona; the config file is unchanged. Open one to restore it.
hide_uses: Still used by {uses}. They keep running on it: hiding only takes it out of the pickers.
function_source_note: (values like keys and tokens are replaced with •••)
devices_footer: Each phone, watch and browser has its own token. Revoking takes effect right away and disconnects it. The hub token used for pairing isn't listed here.
assistant_footer_none: No computer connected yet. Once one is, each chat runs in the background on it. Pick models in Model settings; manage connections and credentials in Model providers.
sidebar_pages_footer: Drag, or use the arrows, to reorder. Pages switched off go under More at the bottom of the sidebar, still a click away, with their badges. The sidebar holds up to {cap} extension pages; more go under More until you switch them on here. Saved in this browser only.
builtin_footer: Plain claude on each computer, with Claude Code's own sign-in and default model. Open it to hide it in Persona.
sync_footer: Whether each computer sent its list this time. One that didn't answer shows its last list, marked on the providers.
